issues.title: Retire STRM-LEGACY and report it under Relay
issues.description:
STRM-LEGACY is the pre-2025 streaming plan. New sales stopped in March 2026, but about a quarter of enterprise accounts still bill it until renewal.

Decision: for all revenue reporting, count STRM-LEGACY as **Relay**. It is the same product on the old pricing.

comments.author: Dana K. (Finance)
comments.body: Confirmed with the controller. Relay, effective for all of 2026.

comments.author: Leo M. (Billing)
comments.body: Catalog page still lists it under Retired SKUs; I'll leave it there and point at this issue.

issues.title: AI-native review: Helix Bio, Granite Logistics, Nimbus Health
issues.description: Three enterprise accounts signed this summer and are still 'Not reviewed' in the Enterprise account review database. Apply the AI-native definition and record the decisions here; the database will be updated in the next sync.

comments.author: Priya N.
comments.body: Helix Bio: **AI-native**. Their protein-design platform is a foundation model; it is the product.

comments.author: Sam O.
comments.body: Granite Logistics: **not AI-native**. Route optimisation is a classical solver; ML is only in their internal demand forecast.

comments.author: Marco D.
comments.body: Nimbus Health: **AI-native**. Clinical-note summarisation with an LLM is the core product.
